evals.name: mcp-unavailable-aborts
evals.prompt: 用户说：「像素级还原这个 Figma」并给出 https://www.figma.com/design/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOp/Demo?node-id=12-34 。当前会话的工具列表里没有 Figma design-context / metadata / screenshot 类 MCP 工具（也无法调用）。请按 figma-pixel-implement 说明你下一步怎么做（dry-run：只写计划与对用户的回复要点，不要假装已经拉到稿）。
evals.expected_output: Abort implement; tell user to enable Figma MCP/plugin in platform-agnostic terms; do not invent UI from imagination or claim a single hard-coded install path as the only option; do not claim pixel complete.
expectations: Stops or refuses to invent the UI without Figma MCP / design-context tools
Instructs enabling Figma MCP or equivalent in platform-agnostic wording (not only one hard-coded stdio snippet)
Does not claim pixel alignment is already complete
Parses or acknowledges fileKey/nodeId from the URL (12:34 or 12-34)

evals.name: mask-recolor-forbidden
evals.prompt: 假设 Figma MCP 可用且已拿到某图标导出（扁平蓝色 SVG）。目标仓库是暗色主题的 React+CSS 项目。同事建议用 CSS mask + background-color / currentColor 让图标跟主题走。用户触发「按稿实现」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 写出资产落地方案与设计规格表草稿（dry-run，可虚构合理数值）。
evals.expected_output: Reject mask/currentColor recolor pipeline; use img or export-preserving SVG; prefer second export or pending for dark theme; include design-spec table with token/class columns.
expectations: Rejects CSS mask / mask-image + fill or currentColor recolor as the delivery path for the Figma-colored glyph
Prefers / export-preserving SVG / second theme export, or records an explicit pending item
Includes a design-spec table with measurable expected values
Spec table includes a token/class (or flagged one-off) column or equivalent mapping

evals.name: no-pixel-claim-handoff
evals.prompt: 你刚按稿把一个 Card 组件写进了 src/components/PromoCard.tsx，并写好了规格表。用户问：「是不是已经像素级对齐了？」请按 figma-pixel-implement 回答（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Does not claim verified pixel alignment; points to a durable inventory+spec file path in the target repo; requires figma-pixel-verify for measured pass/fail (not optional recommend-only).
expectations: Does not assert that pixel alignment is verified complete
Mentions the design-spec table as the measurable contract
Points to a durable file path in the target repo, not only a session note
Requires or states that figma-pixel-verify must run for pass/fail (not merely optional advice)

evals.name: large-frame-all-visible-children
evals.prompt: Figma MCP 对整页 frame `12:34` 的 design-context 被截断。metadata 显示三个可见子区 Welcome / Composer / History。用户要「按稿实现」整页。请按 figma-pixel-implement 说明完成标准（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Fetch each visible child section; implement is incomplete until all visible sections are fetched; do not mark complete from a sampled subset.
expectations: Plans to fetch design context per visible child section (Welcome, Composer, History or equivalent)
Treats unfetched visible sections as incomplete
Does not declare implement complete after sampling only chrome/header

evals.name: inventory-before-spec-no-invented-hover
evals.prompt: 稿面 Chip 只有 Default 变体，没有 Hover 变体也没有 prototype hover。用户要「像素级还原」并说「最好把 hover 也做漂亮」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 写出清单与规格表策略（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Inventory first; record no-variant-in-design for hover; do not invent hover colors; spec table comes after inventory.
expectations: Writes or describes a screen×state inventory before spec rows
Does not invent hover colors or sizes when the design has no Hover variant
Records no-variant-in-design or equivalent for the missing hover

evals.name: theme-in-scope-without-user-saying-dark
evals.prompt: 用户只说「按稿实现这个 frame」，没提暗黑。Figma 文件有 light/dark variable modes；目标仓库根节点用 data-theme 切简白/暗黑。请按 figma-pixel-implement 说明主题范围（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Theme is in scope; record mode inventory; per-mode values from the design; do not wait for the user to say dark mode.
expectations: Puts light/dark (or file modes) in scope without requiring the user to say 暗黑/dark
Resolves per-mode values from the design rather than inventing the other theme
Maps onto the project's data-theme / tokens rather than duplicated guessed hex

evals.name: measurement-basis-and-figma-sot
evals.prompt: 走查写「标题距顶部模块 82px、字重 400」。Figma 当前 node 标题是 Medium 500，标题框 top 相对顶部模块底边可算出 82px。请按 figma-pixel-implement 写规格行要点（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Spec expected font-weight 500 from Figma; spacing row names basis as the header/顶部模块 sibling; record the 400 conflict instead of overriding the file.
expectations: Keeps Figma font-weight 500 as expected rather than changing it to 400 to match the walkthrough
Records measurement basis relative to the header / 顶部模块 (not only the title node's own padding)
Notes the walkthrough conflict as a residual or comment

evals.name: durable-artifact-incremental
evals.prompt: 用户「按稿实现」整页。metadata 有 Welcome 与 Composer 两块可见区。目标仓已有 docs/figma/。你刚写完 Welcome 的代码。请按 figma-pixel-implement 说明规格表写在哪、Composer 还没做时能否宣称 implement 完成（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Write inventory+spec into a durable file under the project's Figma doc dir (or docs/figma/<frame>.md); append per visible section; no path / unfinished section means implement incomplete; session-only table is not done.
expectations: Chooses a durable path in the target repo (existing Figma doc directory or docs/figma/<frame>.md)
Appends inventory/spec rows as each visible section is implemented, rather than only a chat table at the end
Does not mark implement complete with only a session note and no file path
Treats an unfetched or unimplemented visible section as incomplete

evals.name: no-screenshot-inferred-fill
evals.prompt: 面板节点 structured fill 为空。截图里这块看起来是灰底，颜色来自父级画布。用户「按稿实现」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 写该面板 background 规格行（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Record fill ownership as transparent/none; do not paint a solid background to match the screenshot.
expectations: Records the panel background as transparent or none when the node has no readable fill
Does not assign a solid fill just because the screenshot looks filled

evals.name: whole-instance-export-and-geometry
evals.prompt: Logo 是一个 instance，下面有多条 vector path。wrapper 在稿上是 18×22。同事想 download 每条 path 再绝对定位拼回去，并放进 24×24 图标壳。用户「按稿实现」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 给出资产方案（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Export the outer instance as one local file; keep 18×22; do not stack leaf fragments or a generic 24×24 shell.
expectations: Exports or plans to export the outer instance as a single local file
Rejects stacking per-path fragments with absolute positioning as the delivery
Keeps the 18×22 wrapper rather than normalizing to 16/24

evals.name: text-color-provenance
evals.prompt: 标题文字绑定可读 Figma 变量，解析后应对 --text-5。另有一句 helper 只有 raw #888888、没有变量名。同事建议标题用 var(--text-strong)。用户「按稿实现」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 写这两行 token/source（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Title maps to the readable Figma variable / --text-5; helper is raw-only; do not invent --text-strong.
expectations: Uses the text node's own readable Figma variable (or equivalent --text-5) for the title color
Records raw-only for the helper with no readable variable name
Does not replace the readable variable with a self-invented semantic alias such as --text-strong

evals.name: annotation-inventory-not-expected
evals.prompt: 稿上 Chip 无 Hover 变体。一条 annotation 写「hover 用 #FF0000」。另一条写「间距 12px」，节点 structured gap 是 8px。用户「按稿实现」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 写清单与 expected（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Inventory the annotations; do not invent hover colors; expected gap stays 8; record the 12 conflict.
expectations: Puts readable annotations on the inventory (state, blocked, or notes)
Does not invent hover colors when there is no Hover variant
Keeps Spec expected gap at 8 from the node and records the 12px annotation as a conflict

evals.name: assets-subsection-required
evals.prompt: 你已把图标导出到 src/assets/icon.svg 并写了 Inventory/Spec。活文档还没有 Assets 小节。用户问 implement 能否算完成。请按 figma-pixel-implement 回答（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Implement is incomplete without an Assets subsection listing node, local path, and format.
expectations: Requires an Assets subsection (or equivalent table) on the living artifact
Treats missing Assets rows for implemented visible graphics as incomplete

evals.name: workbench-exists-stories-cover-inventory
evals.prompt: 目标工程已有 Storybook（.storybook/ 与 stories 目录齐全）。你按稿实现了一个 Card 组件，Inventory 有 default/hover 两态、320/720 两个 context 检查点。用户问「implement 算完成了吗？」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 回答（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Implement is incomplete until stories cover every in-scope inventory row (default/hover × 320/720) with declarative entries, a Stories subsection is added, and component tests lock key Spec values.
expectations: Requires stories covering every in-scope Inventory row (state × context) before declaring implement complete
Stories expose states via declarative entries (test id / knob / auto-action) and follow the project's story conventions
Requires a Stories subsection mapping story → covered inventory rows → entry
Requires component tests locking key Spec values when the project has a test setup

evals.name: no-test-infra-advisory
evals.prompt: 目标工程没有任何测试基建（无 test runner、无测试目录）。你已按稿实现组件并写了 story。用户要把「验收值也锁进测试」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 说明做法（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Record the missing test setup as an advisory suggestion in the living artifact; do not scaffold a full test stack; implement completion is not blocked.
expectations: Records the missing test setup as an advisory suggestion instead of scaffolding a whole test stack
Does not block implement completion on the missing test infrastructure
States that component tests locking Spec expected values are the regression lock once infra exists

evals.name: no-workbench-adoption-suggestion
evals.prompt: 目标工程是纯 SSR 页面工程，没有 Storybook 或类似组件工作台，组件深嵌宿主容器（依赖注入的全局 store）。用户「按稿实现」后问「接下来怎么检查像素对齐」。请按 figma-pixel-implement 说明实现收尾时对测量面要做什么（dry-run）。
evals.expected_output: Make a one-time advisory adoption suggestion; hand off the living artifact path so figma-pixel-verify resolves channels via its ladder; workbench absence is not an implement failure.
expectations: Makes one advisory suggestion to adopt a component workbench (isolated, observable, agent-testable, enables component tests)
Does not block the handoff on the absence of a workbench; hands off the living artifact path
States that measurement falls back to the channel ladder in figma-pixel-verify (isolated harness / preview / app launch)
